project.name: widocznosc.ai
project.productType: B2B marketing site + free AI-visibility tools (brand by ICEA S.A.)

typography.display: Mona Sans Variable 600, tracking -0.04em, clamp(2.5rem,5.6vw,5rem) for h1
typography.mono: ui-monospace / JetBrains Mono for eyebrows, indexes and mock UI

patterns: hairline rows instead of colored cards
inverse light panel for one highlighted module per page
product mock 1:1 with real tool output

must: Astro components with scoped <style>; React from 21st is inspiration only, port to HTML/CSS
One brand colour; green/amber/red only for results semantics
Primary CTA everywhere: 'Sprawdź widoczność marki' -> /narzedzia/brand-check/; secondary: 'Porozmawiaj z ekspertem ICEA'
'by ICEA' as signature (nav, footer, team, CTA), not a second logo
Show product/data (tool results, numbers with sources), not AI imagery
Polish copy, en-dash only, tabular numerals for data
Light mode must keep working via data-theme tokens
avoid: Gradients as section or card backgrounds, glow orbs, waves, shaders, 'AI' abstract art
More than two CTAs competing in one view
Copying the ICEA key visual wholesale

decisions.decision: Redesign direction: Dayos (big type, black/white base) + Planhat (ordered modules, lead section) + Index (data display). Branch redesign/widocznosc-dayos.

Homepage: direction A 'Raport w ramce' chosen by user over B (bento dashboard) and C (editorial poster+ticker). Split hero with ReportMock in browser frame + sticky HowItWorks; Process section dropped from homepage.

Direction D Instrument typography and width: Fraunces for headings and display numerals, Geist Sans for body/UI, Geist Mono for labels; one 1360px homepage container with only hero copy narrowed for reading. Engine logos use an unframed marquee with a centered label.

Homepage hero uses a centered vertical hierarchy: display headline, wide unboxed SEO-to-answer-engines thesis, then a narrower service promise with two CTAs. The brand-to-ICEA halftone sits directly below it with a lower canvas ratio and denser particles for legibility at 100% browser zoom.

Homepage knowledge section shows the three newest Markdown articles in a three-column editorial grid with 16:9 imagery and Fraunces titles. The global footer aligns to the same 1360px grid as the homepage.
